opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in exceptional cases); most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations and institutions. Not open to: individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution; projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organisation; projects led by schools or FE colleges; projects led by undergraduates or master's students; PhD fees or PhD-supporting projects. Overseas organisations only in exceptional cases.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn); the next outline application deadline is 5 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme is 'Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK'. One deadline per year (Autumn); next deadline 5 October 2026.
